cards.quote: [ 7 ] Double Live was again re-released on November 20 , 2018 , as part of the Garth Brooks Anthology Part III : Live book . Content [ edit ] The song `` Tearin ' It Up ( And Burnin ' It Down ) '' was originally slated for Brooks 's 1997 album Sevens , and `` Wild as the Wind '' was intended for a duets album with Trisha Yearwood .
